description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {R/G}.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Priest of Urabrask on top of your library from your graveyard.
Actviate Impromptu Raid by paying {2}{R/G}, revealing Priest of Urabrask from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
